summary: Volume + value strategy: prioritize 1.5-day Friday trips and three-quarter days for best cost-per-fish ratio.
describe: High-value trip mix: 1.5-day Friday departures (avg 16 yt, $34/fish, no PTO) and three-quarter days (avg 4 yt, $40/fish). Commit PTO for weekday trips 14+ days ahead. Target approximately 50 fish on the season budget with available PTO days.
